purpose: Freeze the V2 supervision contract before any V2 arm is trained. V1 is preserved untouched as the failure/diagnosis baseline.

pseudo_fraction.evidence: V1 A12 sensitivity on PAPER_EVAL_319: ALL corner median 6.967 px at 0.25 vs 7.210 px at 0.50 vs 7.312 px at 0.75, with detection identical at 0.984 in all three. R0 baseline 6.616 px.
pseudo_fraction.note: This is a choice made after seeing development results. It must not be described as a preregistered V1 value.

ambiguity_threshold.evidence: CORNER_REGRESSION_CAUSES.md and generated/AXIS_FAILURES.md: projected squareness q median 0.870 on AXIS_PERMUTED frames vs 0.500 on OK frames; the three newly broken frames sit at 0.797 / 0.955 / 0.964.
ambiguity_threshold.note: Derived from development diagnosis on PAPER_EVAL_319.

supervision_contract.box: top-1 detection exists AND box_conf >= 0.85. Keypoint count does not gate box supervision.
supervision_contract.keypoint_corner: KEEP_i requires kp_conf_i >= 0.5 AND r_remove_i <= 0.05 AND r_flip_i <= 0.05. KEEP -> visibility 2, otherwise visibility 0 (pose loss ignores it).
supervision_contract.keypoint_centroid: index 8 is not a removal-PnP corner. KEEP requires kp_conf_8 >= 0.5 AND r_flip_8 <= 0.05 only.
supervision_contract.ambiguous_frame: q >= 0.75 -> semantic corners 0..7 are all set to visibility 0. Box and centroid supervision are kept. The frame is NOT removed.
supervision_contract.frame_removal: A frame is never dropped for keypoint reasons. Only a missing or low-confidence box removes it.

ambiguity_score.definition: q = min(projected_width, projected_depth) / max(projected_width, projected_depth) where projected_width = ||kp1 - kp0|| and projected_depth = ||kp4 - kp0|| from the teacher prediction
ambiguity_score.invariance_note: min/max makes q unchanged when a yaw90 permutation swaps the two edges; enforced by unit test

synthetic_replay_bins.policy_v2_d: equal exposure across B0/B1/B2 (720 each of 2160 synthetic slots)

architecture.note: YOLO26n-Pose unchanged. No new head, backbone or inference branch. V2 changes training data and the supervision contract only. Inference path is identical to deployment.

known_constraint_keypoint_objectness.implication: visibility=0 is not a pure ignore. Because kpt_shape[-1] == 3, bce_pose(pred_kpt[..., 2], kpt_mask) actively teaches 'not visible' at masked points. Deployment thresholds kp_conf >= 0.5, so the kp_conf distribution is a monitored DEV diagnostic. The kobj gain is NOT changed.

no_threshold_change_after_results: Once this file is committed, V2 thresholds are not changed on the basis of V2 results. A development failure is recorded as V2_METHOD_STATUS = FAILED, not repaired by sweeping.
